customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Toll of Three Riddles
start.text:
''A side path cuts between two leaning pillars, promising to shave an hour off the pass. Halfway through, the air thickens.''

''A shape assembles itself out of dust and old lantern light: vaguely a clerk, vaguely a lion, entirely smug.''

Tollkeeper: Halt. This shortcut is tolled. Has been for nine hundred years. Nobody pays anymore, which I take personally.

''It produces a ledger from nowhere and licks a thumb that is also nowhere.''

Tollkeeper: Coin is worthless to me. Riddles are the currency here. Three answers, three correct, and the path is yours. Fail and you may keep guessing until your hair goes grey. I have time.

900_years.text:
Tollkeeper: Nine hundred and six, but who is counting. I am. I am counting.

''The ledger snaps shut.''

Tollkeeper: The last traveler who passed my toll was a tea merchant with a limp and excellent guesses. You have the look of someone with worse guesses. Shall we find out?

Ask_your_riddles.text:
Tollkeeper: First riddle.

''It clears a throat it does not have.''

Tollkeeper: "I have no mouth, yet I answer every shout thrown at me. The deeper the gorge you stand in, the longer I speak. What am I?"

Echo.text:
Tollkeeper: ''pauses mid-scribble'' An echo. Yes.

''It looks mildly betrayed by your competence.''

Tollkeeper: The pass is full of them. Rude things, echoes. Always getting the last word. One toll paid. Two remain.

The_wind.text:
Tollkeeper: ''makes a slow, delighted noise'' No. No, no, no. Write that down as a no.

''It scribbles in the ledger with theatrical patience.''

Tollkeeper: Again. The gorge is waiting, and so am I. One of us enjoys it.

Second_riddle.text:
Tollkeeper: Second riddle. The miners loved this one. Then the mines closed, and it became mine again.

Tollkeeper: "The more you take away from me, the bigger I become. What am I?"

A_debt.text:
Tollkeeper: A bold guess. A wrong one, but bold.

''The ledger gains another gleeful stroke.''

Tollkeeper: Think like a shovel, traveler. Shovels are not clever, and yet they know this answer.

Hole.text:
Tollkeeper: A hole. Correct.

''It sighs at the ledger.''

Tollkeeper: Half this pass is holes. Ore out, emptiness in, and the emptiness always wins on volume. Two tolls paid. One remains, and it is my favorite.

Last_riddle.text:
Tollkeeper: Final riddle.

''It leans in. The dust of it smells faintly of old incense.''

Tollkeeper: "I change hands a thousand times a day, yet no one keeps me long. I have a face, but no eyes. I speak of worth, yet say nothing. What am I?"

A_rumor.text:
Tollkeeper: ''the ledger practically purrs'' Incorrect. Deliciously incorrect.

Tollkeeper: Think of the thing every merchant in Liyue loves more than sleep. Once more, from the top.

Coin.text:
Tollkeeper: A coin. Three for three.

''For a long moment it says nothing. Then the ledger dissolves into sparks, and the thickness drains out of the air like water out of a cracked pot.''

Tollkeeper: Nine hundred and six years, and the toll is finally paid in full. I am... unemployed. How exciting.

''It gestures, and a small pouch thumps onto the path. It is heavy with silver older than most towns.''

Tollkeeper: Back pay, from travelers who guessed poorly and bribed generously. I have no pockets. You clearly do.

What_will_you_do_now_.text:
Tollkeeper: Do? ''it considers'' I hear echoes are rude. Perhaps I will argue with them. Perhaps I will find a new shortcut and invent worse riddles.

''It begins to unravel at the edges, dust returning to dust, looking happier for it.''

Tollkeeper: Take the pouch, three-for-three. And if anyone asks about the shortcut, tell them the toll is paid forever. I want that on the record.

Toll_of_Three_Riddles__Toll_Paid_in_Full.title: Toll Paid in Full
Toll_of_Three_Riddles__Toll_Paid_in_Full.text:
''The pouch is real, the silver is real, and the shortcut is suddenly just a path again, no thicker than any other air in the pass.''

''Between the leaning pillars, for a heartbeat, you hear a phrase repeat itself down the gorge like a satisfied echo: paid in full, paid in full, paid in full.''
